svg.title: coupling-window lower endpoint makes square roots and reciprocals valid. Chain factors are ordered negative plate–covariance defects followed by the terminal plate factor. Finite products preserve order; quadratic fluctuation and linear defect contractions compare, as do smooth cone cutoffs in squared norms. Blank chains use the viable empty store and identity field with the common plate floor. Condensation is half the blank-minus-actual local determinant difference. The cutoffHaar logarithm is smooth at all arguments: inside support its argument has strict margin within the positive chart, outside it is locally zero, and the margin includes cutoffboundaries.
